column1: # tests/expected/dead_leg_unjudged.tsv — #310 group 7 (14z-221): per row, a gate's control mode and the class
# tests/lib/classify.sh vs_classify_control must give its run with a dead emulator (MAME_BIN=/usr/bin/false), read by
# tests/test_dead_leg_unjudged.sh. Batch 1: the gates with one PRESENT mode in the 14z-215 re-census
# (build/agent215/t310/census57/group7.tsv, local) whose dead-emulator run read HONOURED at HEAD d3e8810d
# (build/agent221/t310g7/base/classes.tsv, local), and audit_dispatch_census's drift-clock (read LIES: a PASS on 0 legs).
# Each row's gate carries `# #310 g7 NJ` on the lines that make it UNJUDGED; the gate's nj-stripped control removes them.
# Batch 2 (14z-221c): the four candidates whose dead-emulator baseline DIED on a traceback (audit_pyron_ring,
# audit_tech_roll, test_down_flash_mechanism, test_random_select_tenants: each read a leg's missing output; each now checks
# its legs first), audit_column_flash under its current mode name (the baseline ran the census's flash-gone, renamed
# flash-planted at 14z-216, so it read REFUSED), test_dualtrack on a dead FBNeo (its leg is FBNeo; its NOT JUDGED lines,
# printed in plain runs too since 14z-215, became vs_ctl_nj), and four group-7 gates with two PRESENT modes that are not
# and two that are (audit_phobos_dmg_residual, audit_tick_phase: their rows there need a PILOT re-trace),
# one row per mode. The fifth column names the instrument made dead with /usr/bin/false (MAME_BIN is always dead too).
# A batch-2 stripped class is the neutered copy's measured class: the copy keeps the new liveness checks, so where the
# baseline DIED it reads HONOURED (the pre-fix gate's own class is the baseline's, build/agent221/t310g7/base/classes.tsv).
# Batch 3 (14z-223): the seven group-7 MAME gates with two or more modes that are not on tests/controls_concurrent_emu.txt
# audit_tick_cadence, test_proof_sheets: 48 modes, test_proof_sheets' tags-dropped added since the census), every mode
# HONOURED on a dead emulator at HEAD c5fe01b4 (build/agent223/t310b3/base/classes.tsv, local). audit_marionette_cost
# reached that HONOURED by a crash: under `set -eu` its section-3 awk read a control leg's missing output and exited 2;
# it now checks both control legs' output first. Its stripped class is the neutered copy's measured class, as batch 2's: the
# copy keeps that check, so it reads HONOURED; the pre-fix gate's HONOURED was tests/lib/classify.sh reading the awk crash's
# exit 2 as the gate's own FAIL, which is DIED by "a crash is not a verdict" (GitHub #367). audit_release_linux_cleanhost (podman) is not in this batch: its
# instrument is found on PATH, not through a *_BIN variable, and it runs on Linux with podman only.
# Batch 4 (14z-223): the group-7 gates on tests/controls_concurrent_emu.txt, 29 gates and 112 rows (two workers' edits,
# checked by one combined dead run, build/agent223/t310b4/after/classes.tsv, local). On a dead emulator at c5fe01b4 their
# modes read HONOURED, or DIED on a Traceback or (by #367's rule) a tool error; six gates now check a dead leg's output
# before reading it. Not rows: audit_victim_parity chains-planted, test_readme_recording unencoded-launcher, crlf-argv and
# rec-log-missing, and test_release_binaries' four modes — each fires on evidence no dead MAME_BIN removes (a static check,
# a host-text guard, or the release binaries the gate runs itself), so it reads HONOURED dead, correctly; and
# audit_latch_reads tap-window-moved, already UNJUDGED before the batch (its own NOT JUDGED line).
# audit_release_linux_desktop (PILOT's desktop only) is left with the podman gate.
# Batch 5 (14z-223): the six held out of batch 1 (build/agent221/t310g7/rc/excluded.txt, local), one row each: the four
# MiSTer gates (test_mister_obj_oracle, test_mister_prg_window, test_mister_sdram_census, test_mister_tenant_oracle), whose
# sim legs find verilator on PATH, so their dead instrument is PATH:verilator (tests/test_dead_leg_unjudged.sh puts a stub
# that exits 1 first on PATH and runs these rows one at a time: the sim legs share one scratch clone);
# audit_stock_emulator_stall, whose mode runs only the WIDE MAME_BIN (with only MAME_REF_BIN dead its live mode honestly
# read HONOURED), which DIED on a Traceback over the dead legs' logs and now checks each leg's END line first; and
# test_release_roundtrip encoder-check-removed, whose instrument is the packager: its planted copy now prints a line where
# the check was, and a copy that never got past it (PATH:python3 dead) is NOT JUDGED. Baseline at f329dc8d on PILOT
# (build/agent223/t310b5/, local): obj_oracle, prg_window, tenant_oracle and roundtrip HONOURED, sdram_census LIES (its
# readout printed CONTROL DEAD on a leg A that never ran; under a mode it is now NOT JUDGED), the stall DIED. The stripped
# classes are the neutered copies' measured classes (batch 2's convention). audit_release_linux_cleanhost (PATH:podman,
# Linux only) and audit_release_linux_desktop (PILOT's desktop only) are not rows yet: on any other host they SKIP before
# any instrument, so their rows need a host condition this table does not have.
